issues: 13.03-13.13 s (frames 391-394): blank frames. Fix: either make the wipe visible (lead it with an ink or accent edge, or use the barber-pole stripe band as the wiping edge, which keeps the match-cut idea) or start l1 at cp.wipe+2 so 'רוצים פרסומת כזו' is already rising while the poster is still on screen. Better: actually grow the after poster INTO the end frame. Keep the wordmark/band and let them settle into the end composition as a sign-off, instead of covering the poster.

6.5-8.0 s (frames 195-203, 210-218, 225-233, 240-248): stacked words are illegible. Fix: make the scissors cut a real split. The old word separates along the cut line (top half slides up, bottom half drops, or the left half falls) and is masked out, and only then does the new word slide in from the cut line. No frame should show two words at more than 20% opacity together. Hold each new word clean for at least 9-10 frames, and draw only one red period.

3.0-3.4 s (frames 90-101): the restyle is a crossfade, not a transformation. Frame 91 ghosts the blue italic 'מספרה 17' over the serif one, frames 94-97 overlap 'תספורת גברים!!' with 'תספורת', and frame 100 overlaps 'פתוח גם בשישי!!!' with the grey 'פתוח גם בשישי'. Fix: morph by moving and scaling each element to its new position with a short hard swap (1 frame) at the midpoint, or mask-wipe the old style off the new style, instead of an opacity crossfade. 'תספורת' and 'זקן' also sit on different baselines (frames 96-101) before the bullet appears; keep them on one line.

3.8-5.0 s (frames 115-150): 1.2 s of completely static frames right after the restyle, in the middle of the spot. Fix: keep something alive on the beat (the red bullet ticks, the CTA pill pops at 120/135, the rule draws, the barber-pole band slides in early), or pull ad.start/band earlier so the wordmark move begins at 135.

5.4 s (frame 162): 'תספורת' fades in over the outgoing 'פתוח גם בשישי' and 'זקן', which is a collision. Fix: clear the old line out completely before the service word arrives, or bring the word in from the scissors side, away from the leftovers.

5-8.5 s (frames 165-255) and 10-11 s (300-330): weak composition. Everything sits in y 368-1172, the lower ~40% of the frame is empty, and the service word is small relative to the space. Fix: move the scissors/word line down to about y 1150-1300, or scale the word up to ~200 px. A secondary detail could use the lower third: the phone number, which disappears for good at ~3.7 s even though the brief says the same information is restyled. Its absence also weakens the before/after promise.

0.0-0.07 s (frames 0-1) and 2.2-2.5 s (66-74): the hook question 'ככה נראית הפרסומת שלך?' is cut at both frame edges. Frame 0 is also the default Reels cover. Fix: start the slam scale so the text never exceeds about x 60-1020 (start at 1.15x, not ~1.25x), or render frame 0 at the settled size and do the slam on frame 1-6.

9.0-9.55 s (frames 270-286): the stripe flood holds for ~0.5 s with no message, and the stripes jump about half a period per frame at 284-286 (diff 71-100), which reads as strobing on phones. Fix: limit the stripe scroll to ≤ 1/4 period per frame (or keep it still and just push the band), and put the 'פתוח' word on top of the flood from ~278, so the drop carries the message.

9.6 s (frames 288-289): the flood retracts and leaves an almost empty frame (8% coverage); 'פתוח' only arrives at ~290, not on stack[0]=288. The 288 audio accent is also missing (+1.7 dB). Fix: land the word on 288 together with a snare/clap.

11.0-11.5 s (330-345): the before/after thumbnails are only 40% scale (432x768) with lots of empty paper around them. Fix: go to 46-48% and tighten the gutter, or crop into the cards. At frame 370 the 'לפני' label is half hidden behind the growing after card; fade it out by 366.

9.0 s drop audio: the drop transient at 270 is -10 dB, and the loudest part (-5 dB) arrives at 275-277, so the hit feels late. Fix: put the kick/boom transient at sample-exact frame 270 and make it the loudest event of the section (+3 dB). Also shift the 362 cut hit 2 frames later to land on 362.

12.4-13.1 s (frames 372-392): the music sags to about -30 dB with no accents on grow (374) or wipe (386), and the labels at 340 are silent. Fix: add a swoosh on 374-386 and a tick on 340 so the compare section has the same density as the word-cut section.

2.0-2.7 s: the strips tear away as hard rectangles. That is OK, but there is no paper-tear edge or sound beyond the 60 hit (62 strips +1.7 dB). Optional: add a ragged tear mask and a rip noise at 62-66 to make the 'tear' concept concrete.
